subject.title: Incomplete turn with tool call and payloads=0 is replayUnsafe and may poison session state

question: For `stopReason=stop`, `payloads=0`, `tools>0`, `replaySafe=no` embedded turns, should OpenClaw preserve the current fail-closed behavior, retry only when current-attempt side effects are proven absent, or quarantine/branch the malformed attempt without retry?
rationale: The source shows the behavior is intentionally guarded by replay-safety metadata; changing it affects duplicate side effects, message delivery, session continuity, and provider fallback behavior.

options.title: Current-attempt-safe retry plus quarantine
options.body: Track current-attempt side effects separately, retry/fallback only when the failed attempt itself is safe, and persist/log a quarantine or branch record when it is not.

options.title: Fail closed with better quarantine only
options.body: Keep replay-unsafe turns non-retryable, but make the abandoned/quarantine outcome durable and diagnostic enough to protect later prompts and operator triage.

options.title: Broader retry despite replayUnsafe
options.body: Retry all empty stop/tool turns even when replay metadata is unsafe, accepting the risk of duplicated side-effectful tool work.

recommendation.title: Current-attempt-safe retry plus quarantine
recommendation.body: Track current-attempt side effects separately, retry/fallback only when the failed attempt itself is safe, and persist/log a quarantine or branch record when it is not.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main blame points to this contributor for the retry helper and incomplete-turn fallback code in this checkout, making them the best available routing owner from inspected history.
